title: Logistics Dashboard
summary: Logistics dashboard with four stat cards across the top row showing vehicle counts (on route, unloading, loading, waiting) with colored icon backgrounds. Second row has a vehicle overview card with tabbed status table (on the way, unloading, loading, waiting counts per category) and a shipment statistics grouped bar chart showing dispatched vs delivered over months. Third row features delivery performance list with icon-coded metrics and percentages, a delivery exceptions donut chart with legend breakdown, and an orders-by-country list with flag icons and category chips. Bottom section has a full-width data table for on-route vehicles with columns for location, start/end routes, warnings, and progress indicators.

layout.columns: 12-column grid: top row has 4 equal stat cards (3 cols each); second row has vehicle overview table (6 cols) and shipment statistics chart (6 cols); third row has delivery performance (4 cols), delivery exceptions donut (4 cols), orders-by-country (4 cols); bottom row is full-width on-route vehicles table (12 cols)
